mapper.sql: create_time , update_time, bool_delete_enum, version, id, project_id, monomer_id, area_id, serial_number, quantity, length, specification, material, net_weight, total_net_weight, produced_quantity, used_quantity, remark, drawing_number, machine_part_id, machine_part_front, area_type, bool_send_directly
mapper.select:
SELECT ass.*, u.name user_name, cofnig.name As configName FROM tech_assemble as ass left join sys_user u on ass.user_id = u.id and u.bool_delete_enum = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_assemble_config cofnig on cofnig.id = ass.assemble_config_id
INNER JOIN sys_monomer_user_link AS link ON ass.monomer_id = link.monomer_id AND link.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND link.deepened_person_id = #{userId}
where ass.area_id = #{areaId} and ass.bool_delete_enum = 0
and ass.serial_number LIKE concat('%', #{serialNumber}, '%')
and ass.specification like concat('%', #{specification}, '%')
and ass.material like concat('%', #{material}, '%')
AND ass.area_batch_id = #{areaBatchId}
select id from tech_assemble where bool_delete_enum = 0 and area_id = #{areaId}

SELECT sc.NAME classificationName, sc.id classificationId, ta.material material, IFNULL(sum(ta.quantity), 0) quantity, IFNULL(sum(ta.totalNetWeight), 0) totalNetWeight FROM ( SELECT assemble_config_id, material, SUM(quantity) quantity, SUM(total_net_weight) totalNetWeight FROM tech_assemble WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND bool_delete_enum = 0 GROUP BY assemble_config_id, material ) AS ta LEFT JOIN sys_assemble_config AS sc ON ta.assemble_config_id = sc.id AND sc.bool_delete_enum = 0 GROUP BY sc.NAME, ta.material, sc.id ORDER BY sc.id ASC

SELECT cp.id 'project.id', cp.`name` 'project.name', cp.serial_number 'project.serialNumber', cp.short_name 'project.shortName', pm.id 'monomer.id', pm.`name` 'monomer.name', pa.id 'area.id', pa.`name` 'area.name', a.id, a.serial_number, a.specification, a.material, a.quantity, a.user_id 'user.id', u.username 'user.name' FROM tech_assemble a LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON a.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN contract_project cp ON cp.id = a.project_id LEFT JOIN plan_monomer pm ON pm.id = a.monomer_id LEFT JOIN plan_area pa ON pa.id = a.area_id WHERE a.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND a.id = #{productId}
select round(sum((ifnull(a.quantity, 0) * ifnull(a.net_weight, 0)) / 1000), 2) as ton from tech_assemble a where a.bool_delete_enum = 0 and a.project_id = #{projectId}

SELECT mp.id, mp.bool_status_enum, mp.serial_number, mp.specification, mp.length, mp.material, mp.net_weight, mp.gross_weight, mp.user_id, mp.net_weight * a.quantity * ampl.quantity AS total_net_weight, mp.gross_weight * a.quantity * ampl.quantity AS total_gross_weight, mp.surface_area /1000000 surface_area, (select name from sys_user where bool_delete_enum = 0 and id = mp.user_id ) AS user_name, a.quantity * ampl.quantity AS quantity, mp.remark, mp.bool_scheduling_enum, mp.bool_process FROM tech_assemble_detail AS ampl INNER JOIN tech_assemble AS mp ON ampl.assemble_id = mp.id AND mp.bool_delete_enum = 0 INNER JOIN tech_artifact AS a ON ampl.artifact_id = a.id AND mp.bool_delete_enum = 0 WHERE ampl.artifact_id = #{artifactId} AND ampl.bool_delete_enum = 0 order by mp.id asc
